Remark
[equivalent definitions of convexity on an interval]

Source: petersen:page-0322, petersen:page-0323 ↗ def:pet-ch7-support-function 1. ch7:7.5.3Let $f:I\to \mathbb {R}$ be continuous on an interval $I\subset \mathbb {R}$. Show that (1) $f$ is convex, (2) $f$ has a linear support function from below of the form $a(x-x_0)+f(x_0)$ at every $x_0\in I$, and (3) $f''\ge 0$ in the support sense at every $x_0\in I$, are equivalent.
